blocks.text: Brentwood Park home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

14 townhomes sold in Brentwood Park with a median price of $1,070,000 (the middle half sold between $878,350 and $1,236,000), taking a median of 16 days to sell at 98.3% of the last list price; 0% sold above list. They had a median $671 per square foot, a median year built of 2018 and a median strata fee of $367 a month.

blocks.text: Brentwood Park Townhomes: streets and boundaries

items.t: Brentwood Park's townhome question is a street question: the ground-oriented stock sits on the established streets south of Lougheed Highway — Springer Avenue is the street the City's own applications name for street-oriented townhouses — while the towers rise on the town-centre lots north and east of those streets.

blocks.text: Brentwood Park Townhomes: the housing stock

items.t: Standalone townhouse complexes are the minority form here: most "townhouse" units in Brentwood Park are street-fronting townhouse units at the base of tower projects, a form the City's applications state expressly — for example, the Boffo Developments phase at Springer Avenue and Lougheed Highway is a high-rise building "with street orientated townhouses atop underground parking."

The same pattern appears at the town centre's west edge, where a Dawson Street application is described by the City as a multi-family residential building "with street fronting townhouses, and above and below grade structured parking."
A buyer here is therefore usually buying a strata lot inside a tower strata, with the tower's Form B, depreciation report and parkade — not a lot in a townhouse-only complex.

blocks.text: Brentwood Park Townhomes: rules that affect buyers

items.t: A tower-base townhouse is still a strata lot: the Province states all strata residential rental-restriction bylaws are invalid as of November 24, 2022, only a 55-or-older age bylaw is allowed, and short-term rental bylaws remain allowed — so the registered bylaws of the tower strata, not a townhouse-complex rulebook, govern the unit.

The Zoning Bylaw 2026's Form and Character Development Permit Area guidelines exempt R1 Small-Scale Multi-Unit Housing uses proposed in an R2 Townhouse district from a form and character permit, except supportive housing — a small-infill rule that matters on the Springer Avenue house streets.
Burnaby 2050, adopted December 9, 2025, takes precedence over older community-plan land-use maps where they conflict.

blocks.text: Brentwood Park Townhomes: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: Two projects with near-identical names are not the same tenure: SHAPE's own page for The Amazing Brentwood states Tower ONE's 300 rental homes are professionally managed by SHAPE, while the same master plan's other towers are strata — a townhouse or condo buyer must check which tower a listing is in.

SHAPE states The Amazing Brentwood is a 28-acre master plan at 4567 Lougheed Highway with over 6,000 homes over 11 residential towers at completion, SkyTrain connected on site, and homes in Neighbourhood Two now selling — the construction context around the established townhouse streets.

The federal contribution to Brentwood Block is on the public record: Canada Mortgage and Housing Corporation (CMHC) states the two buildings at 2132 Alpha Avenue and 4608 Lougheed Highway are part of the 7.9-acre Brentwood Block site, with 1,279 rental units, 160,000 square feet of commercial space and 451 condominiums in Phase 1.

Brentwood Block's civic piece is a City-owned building, not a strata amenity: Grosvenor states the new 100,000 square foot Brentwood Community Centre will be City-owned, with an anticipated completion of late 2029, and that the master plan also includes a daycare.

blocks.text: Brentwood Park Townhomes: development and new projects

items.t: Brentwood Block (Grosvenor), Alpha Avenue at Lougheed Highway — CMHC names the Phase 1 buildings at 2132 Alpha Avenue and 4608 Lougheed Highway: 7.9-acre pedestrian-focused master plan. Phase 1 — 41-storey strata tower, two rental towers, 1,279 rental homes, new 100,000 sq ft City-owned Brentwood Community Centre (Grosvenor estimates completion late 2029) and 180,000 sq ft commercial. STATUS: construction started, per the developer, read 2026-11-03. Full master plan: about 3,500 homes including 2,450 rental.

Bassano / Springer Avenue phase, portion of 2160 and 2210 Springer Avenue and portion of 5334 Lougheed Highway (Boffo Developments Ltd.), rezoning REZ #21-30: Phase 1 high-rise, 318 market strata homes in Tower 1, with street-oriented townhouses atop underground parking. STATUS: Third Reading April 29, 2024, on the City list updated October 27, 2026, read 2026-11-03.

Springer Avenue Tower, 2209 and 2225 Springer Avenue (Millennium Properties Ltd.), rezoning REZ #25-20: single high-rise apartment tower up to 49 storeys including a 9-storey terraced podium with street-fronting retail; the City's unit count lists 387 market homes and 34 non-market rental homes. STATUS: Third Reading October 27, 2026, read 2026-11-03.

The Amazing Brentwood master plan amendment, portion of 4567 Lougheed Highway (SHAPE Properties Corp.), rezoning REZ #23-15: revised site plan with updated height and massing, adding non-market housing, child care and parks policies. STATUS: Final Adoption May 26, 2026, read 2026-11-03. Tower 8 and Tower 9 applications (REZ #24-08 and #24-09) are at Initial Report June 10, 2024 on the same list.

blocks.text: Brentwood Park Townhomes: costs and taxes

items.t: A Hastings Business Improvement Area (BIA) levy exists in north Burnaby but not in Brentwood: the Burnaby Rates Bylaw 2026 (Bylaw No. 14814) sets a Hastings BIA rate of 0.65242 per $1,000 on Class 6 (Business and Other) only, and notes the Burnaby North Road BIA expired March 31, 2026 — a Brentwood townhouse owner does not pay a BIA levy on a residential unit.
The multi-family utility line a townhouse strata budgets from is the City's 2026 Multiple Family Dwelling rate: water $374.54 and sewer use $436.00 per year, before the 5% early-payment discount.

blocks.text: Brentwood Park Townhomes: getting around

items.t: Brentwood Town Centre Station (Millennium Line) sits above Lougheed Highway east of Willingdon Avenue, between Gilmore Station west and Holdom Station east, and is the station for both the tower lots and the Springer Avenue streets.

The R2 Marine–Willingdon RapidBus added a Brentwood stop on September 7, 2026: TransLink states the extension runs from Phibbs Exchange to Metrotown Station via Hastings Street and Willingdon Avenue, all day, seven days a week, and replaced the peak-only 222 Willingdon Express.

blocks.text: Brentwood Park Townhomes: risks and due diligence

items.t: Streamside setback is the south-edge check to ask about: a ground-oriented lot at the area's south edge should be checked for a streamside protection area on the City's mapping before an addition is planned — a lot-level check a tower strata unit does not carry.

For a tower-base townhouse, the depreciation report belongs to the whole tower strata: the Province's updated depreciation report requirements (effective July 1, 2024) apply to the tower's systems — parkade, elevators, envelope — which the townhouse owner shares.
